---
name: Defect
about: Something is wrong. Cite it.
labels: bug
---

## What breaks

What goes wrong, and what a person sees when it does. Name the behaviour, not the
file. One paragraph.

## Evidence

At least one citation: a path such as `src/x.ts:41` becomes a permalink, or link a
commit, an issue or a log line.

## Remediation

- [ ] The change that fixes it
- [ ] The check that would have caught it

## Out of scope

What this issue deliberately does not cover, so it can be closed.
